'''Runner''' is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]. 

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:RunnerNES1.png|80px]]

First appearing in [[Death Valley|Act 2-2]], Runners are true to their name. They are similar to [[Dog]]s in that they are very fast, easily catching up with Ryu from behind. However, upon reach a ledge or wall, Runners jump forward in a high arc to navigate terrain and smack Ryu midair. Runners can also spawn in jumping forward. Their contact only does 1 damage, and they are easily defeated in one hit.

==Trivia==
* In the original NES game, the enemy's design is a subject of debate. On one side, their helmet and posture lends them to be football players charging forward. On the other, they are military soldiers/commandos in sharing the same palette as the [[Gunner]]s, enemies they are commonly paired with.
** However, in the PC Engine version, they were more clearly represented as football players, with the addition of orange accenting and more noticeable football gear.
